entries.text: Linked issue n/a: no Linear ticket (skipped for this project). Close-out of the nested-transactions project, delivered in #31048, #31050, #31053, #31073, #31106, #31120 and #31121. Summary Nested transactions via savepoints have shipped: tx.transaction(cb) on every SQL facade, and ORM writes of several statements run in a savepoint inside a transaction. This PR closes the project: ADR 326, "A nested transaction is a savepoint", records decisions 1–10 of the project spec as shipped, with the alternatives rejected and why. ADR 271 links to it, and three statements in ADR 271 that the shipped code no longer matched are fixed (the handle's transaction is no longer optional, inTransaction() is on the handle, and tx has a transaction method). Three framework tests fill a gap in the project DoD: finalize outcomes and order for a released savepoint whose statements all succeed, a savepoint released inside a released savepoint, and a savepoint released inside one that then rolls back. No production code changes. projects/nested-transactions/ is deleted. The final retro was skipped at the operator's request. Project DoD # Item Status Evidence 1 The At a glance example on PGlite, MySQL (live) and SQLite: A and C committed, B not Met packages/3-targets/postgres/9-facade/test/nested-transactions.integration.test.ts ("commits the work around a nested transaction that threw, and not the work inside it, on a %s client", pooled and serverless); packages/3-targets/mysql/3-live-tests/test/suite

The DCO status check will block merge if any commit is missing a Signed-off-by: trailer. I read CONTRIBUTING.md and the change is scoped to one logical concern. Tests are updated (or n/a if the change is doc-only / refactor with no behavioural delta). The PR title is in TML-NNNN: <sentence-case title> form (Linear ticket prefix + concise title naming the concrete deliverable). See .claude/skills/create-pr/SKILL.md for the full convention. The Skill update section above is filled in (or stated n/a — internal only). Notes for the reviewer What changed Fixed foreign-key ownership detection for same-space to-one relations in the SQL contract validator. relation-storage.ts:43-62: resolveSqlToOneRelationStorage now matches a foreign key by its full coordinate — source columns and target table and target columns — instead of source columns alone. validators.test.ts:800-877: added regression tests for a shared-PK 1:1 chain (class-table inheritance). Why In shared-primary-key 1:1 chains, every table's primary key is also a foreign key to its parent. The previous logic misidentified the back-relation as owning the FK because the local columns coincided with the table's upward FK. This caused valid nullable chained 1:1 relations

entries.text: Summary Adds direct test coverage for UniqueConstraint in packages/2-sql/1-core/contract/src/ir/unique-constraint.ts, including the static from() factory's pass-through vs. construct branches. unique-constraint.ts: 100% statements/branches/functions/lines (up from 83%/75%/100%/100%) Related to the M9 target-extensible-IR coverage gap noted in coverage.config.json (TML-2521). Summary by CodeRabbit Tests Expanded automated coverage for unique constraint creation with and without a name, ensuring instances remain immutable. Added checks for converting plain input into a unique constraint and returning an existing constraint unchanged. These tests verify expected behavior across the supported construction and conversion scenarios; no end-user functionality changes are included in this update.
